item.title: Democratic Party "Jang Dong-hyuk Exploits the Spirit of Jesus to Justify Insurrection…Appalling" (민주 “장동혁, 예수 정신을 내란 정당화에 악용…참담”)
item.description:
In response to remarks by People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, who said, "I’m not sure what harm the (emergency) martial law has caused the people or what chaos it has brought," the Democratic Party of Korea criticized him, stating, "Not only has he reverted to a 'Yoon again' stance, but he has also trampled on the hearts of the people wounded by the insurrection." (“(비상)계엄이 국민에게 상처를 주고 어떤 혼란을 가져왔을지 모르겠다”는 장동혁 국민의힘 대표 발언을 두고 더불어민주당이 “‘윤 어게인’으로 회귀하는 것도 모라자 내란으로 상처 입은 국민의 마음까지 짓밟았다”고 비판했다.)

Democratic Party Senior Spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun made these comments on the 9th in a written briefing, referencing Jang’s statements during a press conference with foreign correspondents hosted by the Seoul Foreign Correspondents' Club the previous day. ( 강준현 민주당 수석대변인은 9일 서면브리핑에서 전날 서울외신기자클럽 초청 외신기자 간담회에서의 장 대표 발언들을 언급하며 이같이 말했다. )

Spokesperson Kang criticized, "(The martial law) has regressed South Korea, a democracy's top student, to levels from 45 years ago, dealt economic shocks like a sharp rise in exchange rates, damaged the nation's image, and driven people into the streets to overcome the insurrection, disrupting their peaceful daily lives. How can he claim not to know what harm and confusion the insurrection has caused the people?" ( 강 대변인은 “(계엄은) 민주주의 우등생 대한민국을 45년 전 수준으로 후퇴시키고, 환율 급등 등 경제적 충격을 줬으며 국가 이미지를 실추시켰고, 국민을 내란 극복을 위한 광장으로 내몰아 국민의 평온한 일상을 파괴했다”며 “이런데도 내란이 국민들에게 어떤 상처와 혼란을 줬는지 모르겠느냐”고 비판했다. )

Regarding Jang’s comment that "impeachment is not the only way to resolve martial law," Spokesperson Kang said, "This is Yoon Suk Yeol, who said they could impose martial law even two or three times if needed. Does Jang truly not understand why the people desperately cried out for Yoon’s impeachment?" ( 강 대변인은 “계엄을 해결하는 유일한 방법이 탄핵은 아니”라는 장 대표의 발언에 대해서도 “계엄을 두 번 세 번이라도 하면 된다고 말했던 윤석열이다. 장 대표는 국민이 왜 절실한 마음으로 윤석열의 탄핵을 외쳤는지 정말 모르겠느냐”고 했다. )

He further criticized, "It is utterly appalling to see the spirit of Jesus, which symbolizes love and sacrifice, being exploited to justify their own acts of insurrection." Jang, who was one of 18 People Power Party lawmakers who participated in the National Assembly vote to lift the emergency martial law, later appeared at a rally opposing the impeachment of former President Yoon Suk Yeol three months later and said, "What is your conclusion on the impeachment trial? The correct answer is the dismissal of the impeachment. There is God's plan even in this martial law." When a journalist brought up this shift in stance at the press conference, Jang responded, "God accomplished the history of salvation He intended through the event of Judas betraying Jesus. That is my faith as a Christian." ( 이어 “사랑과 헌신을 상징하는 예수의 정신을 자신들의 내란 행위 정당화에 악용하는 모습도 참담하기 그지없다”고 비판했다. 비상계엄 해제 국회 표결에 참여한 국민의힘 의원 18명 가운데 한 명인 장 대표는 3개월 뒤 윤석열 전 대통령 탄핵 반대 집회에 나와 “탄핵 심판에 대한 여러분의 결론은 무엇인가. 정답은 탄핵 기각이다. 이번 계엄에도 하나님의 계획이 있다”고 말한 바 있다. 간담회에서 한 기자가 이러한 행보를 거론하자 장 대표는 “하나님은 유다가 예수님을 배신하는 사건을 통해서도 하나님께서 이루고자 하는 구원의 역사를 이루셨다. 그게 크리스천으로서의 제 믿음”이라고 말했다. )

He added, "I’m not sure what harm the martial law has caused the people or what chaos it has brought," and said, "As time passes, it (the martial law) will become another event through which South Korea can overcome those wounds and move forward in a different form." ( 그러면서 “계엄이 국민에게 상처를 주고 어떤 혼란을 가져왔을지 모르겠다”며 “시간이 지나면 그것(계엄)을 통해서 대한민국은 그 상처를 딛고 또 다른 모습으로 나아갈 수 있는 또 하나의 사건”이라고 덧붙였다. )

In response, Spokesperson Kang said, "What exists in the emergency martial law is not God's plan, but the people's resolute judgment. Jang should reflect on whether he truly has the qualification to appeal for the people's choice. If he does, he is the perfect party leader for the insurrectionist People Power Party." ( 이를 두고 강 대변인은 “비상계엄에 있는 것은 하나님의 계획이 아니라, 국민의 단호한 심판”이라며 “장 대표는 정말 국민의 선택을 호소할 자격이 있는지 스스로 되돌아봐야 한다. 만약에 자격이 있다면 내란당 국민의힘에 안성맞춤 당대표”라고 덧붙였다. )

Reporter Lee Yu-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr ( 이유진 기자 yjlee@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jeon Han-gil to Jang Dong-hyuk: "What Were You Doing When I Was Handcuffed?" ... Another Party Convention Invoice (전한길, 장동혁에 “나 수갑 찰 때 뭐했냐”…또 전당대회 청구서)
item.description:
Far-right YouTuber Jeon Han-gil took aim at People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk, asking, "You said you'd push 'Yoon Again,' so we made you party leader—but what were you doing when I was handcuffed?"—once again presenting his "party convention invoice." <<> In his YouTube livestream on the 9th, Jeon claimed, "At last August's PPP convention, why did Jang become party leader by beating (candidate) Kim Moon-soo? I can't say it's entirely because of me, but Jang said he'd fight electoral fraud and push Yoon Again, so I made you party leader, didn't I?" <<> Then Jeon raised his voice, asking, "Jang Dong-hyuk, did you help when Jeon Han-gil was handcuffed? Did you even raise your voice once?" and "Kim Min-soo, Supreme Council member, we made you a Supreme Council member. But what have you done for Jeon Han-gil?" <<> Earlier, on the 16th of last month, Jeon's arrest warrant was dismissed on charges of defaming President Lee Jae-myung and Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok. At the time, during the pre-arrest interrogation (warrant review), he was handcuffed, which he referenced to express disappointment toward Representative Jang and Supreme Council member Kim. <<> This is not Jeon's first invoice. Jeon, who left the PPP on the 5th of last month, argued as early as last February, "Whether it's Jang Dong-hyuk or Kim Min-soo, keep the promises you made to party members at last year's convention and stay true to your original intent" and "If you abandon Yoon Again and the fight against electoral fraud because it's bad for the election, we will unconditionally abandon (Representative Jang) too." <<> However, Jeon did not rule out the possibility that the 'severance from Yoon' (cutting ties with Yoon Seok-yeol) might be a 'strategy' ahead of the June 3 local elections. Jeon said, "I'll believe you. You say you're strategically breaking with Yoon ahead of the election. But let's see after the local elections. We'll see whether it was sincere or false" and added, "I hope you answer and face judgment then—whether to break with Yoon or stick with Yoon Again." <<> Meanwhile, Jeon has announced his intention to form a new party after the June 3 local elections. Kim Hyun-tae, former commander of the Army Special Warfare Command's 707th Special Mission Group, who has been attending far-right rallies and appearing on YouTube broadcasts alongside Jeon, declared his candidacy for the Incheon Gyeyang-e by-election, saying, "I will bring down the Lee Jae-myung regime." On this day, Jeon also stated, "Now, I'll do everything—politics and all—just wait and see." <<> Reporter Lee Yoo-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr (극우 유튜버 전한길씨가 장동혁 국민의힘 대표를 향해 “‘윤 어게인’ 하겠다고 해서 당 대표 만들어줬는데 내가 수갑 찰 때 뭘 했느냐”라며 또 ‘전당대회 청구서’를 내밀었다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Election Committee Launches... Daegu Surgeon and Naturalized Korean from Myanmar Among New Members (민주당 선대위 출범…대구 외과의사·미얀마 출신 귀화 한국인 등 합류)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, announced on the 10th, "This election committee is a grand unity and all-embracing committee that has brought in new people carrying the people's wishes," revealing four senior standing committee chairs recruited from outside the party. They include former Chungbuk Governor Lee Si-jong, Daegu-born surgeon Geum Hee-jung, naturalized Korean Lee Bo-na from Myanmar, and Ahn Seon-ha, a consultant for the World Health Organization (WHO). (정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 10일 “이번 선거대책위원회는 국민의 염원을 담아 새로운 분을 모아낸 대통합, 대포용 통합형 선대위”라며 당 외부에서 영입한 상임선대위원장 4명을 발표했다. 이시종 전 충북지사, 대구 출신의 외과의사 금희정씨, 미얀마 출신의 귀화 한국인 이본아씨, 안선하 세계보건기구(WHO) 자문관 등이다.)

At the 'Republic of Korea National Normalization Election Committee Launch Ceremony' held at the National Assembly that day, Representative Jung formalized the transition to a central election committee and announced these appointments, stating, "It embodies the Democratic Party's commitment to being a large vessel that holds the voices of all citizens." (정 대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 ‘대한민국 국가정상화 선거대책위원회 출범식’에서 중앙선거대책위 전환을 공식화하고 “모든 국민의 목소리를 담는 커다란 그릇이 되겠다는 민주당의 의지를 담았다”며 이런 인선을 발표했다.)

Regarding former Governor Lee Si-jong, Representative Jung said, "He has served as Yeongwol County Mayor, three terms as Chungju City Mayor, two terms as Chungju's National Assembly member, and three terms as Chungbuk Governor—boasting an eight-win, undefeated electoral record," adding, "We tried to bring him in from the start. We expect him to take charge of a winning election strategy." About Ahn Seon-ha, he said, "She is currently a WHO consultant in climate, AI, and health," describing her as "a multi-talented figure experienced in international development, urban policy, AI, climate, health, and gender research." (정 대표는 이시종 전 지사에 대해 “영월군수, 충주시장 3선, 충주시 국회의원 재선을 거쳐 3선 충북지사까지 지낸 8전8승 전승 선거이력을 가진 분”이라며 “처음부터 모셔오려고 노력했다. 이기는 선거 전략을 책임져주리라 기대한다”고 말했다. 안선하 자문관에 대해서는 “현 세계보건기구 기후·인공지능·건강 분야 자문관”이라며 “국제개발, 도시정책, 인공지능, 기후, 보건, 젠더 연구를 모두 경험한 멀티플레이형 인재”라고 했다.)

On Geum Hee-jung, he stated, "She is the daughter of the TK (Daegu-Gyeongbuk) region, a Daegu citizen and surgeon, widely known for her supporting speech for then-candidate Lee Jae-myung last May," recalling, "I vividly remember her saying, 'Please trust Lee Jae-myung's promise to create a world where we can all live well for Daegu and Gyeongbuk, and vote.' It was tearfully moving." About Lee Bo-na, he said, "She is a naturalized Korean from Myanmar active in various fields," adding, "As multicultural families grow in number, we expect her to raise her voice on policies to improve their quality of life." (금희정씨에 대해서는 “티케이(TK)의 딸로 대구시민이자 외과의사로 지난 5월 이재명 대통령 당시 후보 찬조연설로 널리 알려진 분”이라며 “대구·경북을 위해 우리 모두 먹고살만한 세상을 만들겠다는 이재명 후보의 약속을 믿고 꼭 투표해달라고 말한 기억이 생생하다. 눈물나게 고마웠다”고 말했다. 이본하씨에 대해서는 “미얀마 출신의 귀화 한국인으로 다양한 분야에서 활동하고 있다”며 “다문화 가정이 점점 늘어나고 있는데, 다문화 가족의 삶의 질을 높이기 위한 정책도 많이 담당해서 목소리를 낼 것으로 기대한다”고 말했다.)

Actor Lee Won-jong was also appointed as head of the Alleyway Election Committee. Representative Jung remarked, "He is too famous to need an introduction" and "He made incredibly devoted contributions in the last presidential election as well. We look forward to his active role." (배우 이원종씨도 골목골목선대위원장으로 임명됐다. 정 대표는 “소개가 필요 없을 정도로 너무 유명한 분”이라며 “지난 대선 때도 너무나 헌신적으로 공헌해주셨다. 맹활약을 기대한다”고 말했다.)

Representative Jung stated, "This local election is not merely about picking regional workers but is a crucial election to normalize the Republic of Korea and confidently open the path for a great leap forward," adding, "That's why we set the slogan as 'Normalizing the Republic of Korea, Local Governments that Work Well.'" He said, "We must win this election to uproot the ongoing provocations of insurrectionary forces," adding, "We need to support the success of the Lee Jae-myung government through victory in this local election. Today, we begin the great journey of the National Normalization Election Committee to fulfill that historic mission." (정 대표는 “이번 지선은 단순히 지역 일꾼을 뽑는 선거가 아니라 대한민국을 정상화하고 대한민국 대도약의 길을 당당히 열어낼 중요한 선거”라며 “그래서 구호로 ‘대한민국 국가정상화, 일 잘하는 지방정부’로 정했다”고 말했다. 그는 “이번 선거에서 반드시 승리해야 여전히 계속되고 있는 내란세력의 준동을 뿌리 뽑을 수 있다”며 “지선 승리로 이재명 정부의 성공을 뒷받침해야 한다. 오늘 그 시대적 소명을 완수하기 위한 대한민국 국가정상화 선대위 대장정을 시작한다”고 말했다.)

The election committee will be led jointly by Representative Jung and Floor Leader Han Byeong-do as co-standing chairs. Representative Jung will also serve as the general election chair. Seven top Democratic Party councilors—including Lee Eon-ju, Hwang Myeong-seon, Kang Deuk-gu, Lee Seong-yoon, Moon Jeong-bok, Park Ji-won, and Park Gyu-hwan—have been listed as co-election chairs. (선거대책위원회는 정 대표와 한병도 원내대표가 공동 상임위원장을 맡아 지휘한다. 정 대표는 총괄선대위원장도 겸임한다. 이언주·황명선·강득구·이성윤·문정복·박지원·박규환 등 민주당 최고위원 7명은 공동선대위원장에 이름을 올렸다.)

Reporter Go Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk to pro-Trump media: "Lee Jae-myung government, pro-North, pro-China, socialist forces" (장동혁, 친트럼프 매체에 “이재명 정부, 친북·친중·사회주의 세력”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, claimed in a contribution to a U.S. conservative online outlet that the Lee Jae-myung government is a "pro-China, pro-North Korea, socialist, rule-of-law-destroying force." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 미국 보수 성향 온라인 매체에 기고한 글에서 이재명 정부를 “친중·친북·사회주의·법치주의 파괴 세력”이라고 주장했다.)

In an article published on the 9th (local time) in the Washington D.C.-based pro-Trump, conservative internet media outlet 'The Daily Caller', Representative Jang cited examples such as the ban on civilian organizations distributing anti-North Korea leaflets and the expressed intent to reduce South Korea-U.S. joint military exercises, asserting that the Lee Jae-myung government "is pursuing a conciliatory North Korea and China policy, including declaring a full restoration of South Korea-China relations and stating respect for the North Korean regime." (장 대표는 9일(현지시각) 미국 워싱턴DC를 기반으로 한 친트럼프·보수 성향 인터넷 매체 ‘데일리 콜러’에 한 기고에서 민간단체의 대북전단 살포 금지, 한미 연합군사훈련 축소 의사 표명 등을 예로 들어 이재명 정부가 “한중 관계의 완전한 복원을 선언하고 북한 체제를 존중한다고 밝히는 등 유화적 대북·대중 정책을 펴고 있다”고 주장했다.)

He also declared unconditional support for the United States, stating, "(The Lee Jae-myung government) must choose one of two paths: whether to stand clearly and unconditionally on the side of the free world (the U.S.) or not stand at all." Representative Jang's contribution appears aimed at stoking distrust of the Lee Jae-myung government among U.S. and domestic conservative forces ahead of the June 3 local elections. (그는 “(이재명 정부가) 자유세계(미국) 편에 분명하고 조건 없이 설 것인지, 아예 서지 않을 것인지 둘 중 하나를 선택해야 한다”며 미국을 향한 무조건적 지지를 밝히기도 했다. 장 대표의 기고는 6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 미국과 국내 보수세력에 이재명 정부에 대한 불신을 부추기려는 것으로 보인다.)

Representative Jang also emphasized security concerns, claiming that "South Korea faces a comprehensive crisis." (장 대표는 “대한민국은 포괄적인 위기에 직면해 있다”고 주장하며 안보 불안을 강조하기도 했다.)

He stated, "(South Korea) has become a country that cannot effectively respond to espionage activities by Chinese Communist Party agents," and added, "Over the past five years, there have been concentrated cases of technology theft targeting global Korean companies like Samsung and SK." Citing instances during the same period where Chinese nationals used drones to illegally film major military facilities such as Busan, Jeju, the area near the National Intelligence Service, and Osan Air Base, he also claimed that "South Korea's economic and security sovereignty is being steadily eroded." (그는 “(대한민국이) 중국 공산당 요원들의 간첩 행위에 효과적으로 대응하지 못하는 나라가 됐다”며 “지난 5년간 삼성, 에스케이와 같은 세계적인 한국 기업을 겨냥한 기술 탈취가 집중적으로 발생했다”고 말했다. 같은 기간 중국 국적자들이 드론을 이용해 부산, 제주, 국가정보원 인근, 오산 공군기지 등 주요 군사시설을 불법 촬영한 사례가 있었다는 점을 들어 “한국의 경제 및 안보 주권이 꾸준히 침식되고 있다”고도 주장했다.)

Representative Jang also linked the Lee Jae-myung government's judicial reform bills to the South Korea-U.S. alliance. He said, "An alliance is not just about exchanging promises but building trust, and that trust is maintained through democratic governance tied to the rule of law. However, South Korea's rule of law collapsed when the Lee Jae-myung government passed judicial reform bills last March." (장 대표는 이재명 정부의 사법개혁 법안을 한미 동맹과 결부시키기도 했다. 그는 “동맹은 단순히 약속을 주고받는 게 아니라 신뢰를 쌓는 것이며, 그 신뢰는 법치로 연동된 민주적 국정운영을 통해 유지된다”며 “그런데 한국 법치는 이재명 정부가 지난 3월 사법개혁 법안을 통과시키면서 무너졌다”고 했다.)

Representative Jang further claimed, "They increased the number of judges in a way that allows political influence and introduced a four-tier trial system that can even overturn Supreme Court rulings." He also referred to the Democratic Party of Korea as a "socialist-leaning ruling party" and alleged that through the judicial reform bills, "they made it possible to indict judges and prosecutors whenever they wish." (장 대표는 이어 “정치적 영향력이 미칠 수 있는 방식으로 판사 수를 늘리고, 대법원 판결조차 뒤집을 수 있는 4심제를 도입했다”고 주장했다. 또 그는 더불어민주당을 “집권한 사회주의 성향 민주당”이라고 지칭하며, 사법개혁 법안을 통해 “원할 때마다 판사와 검사를 기소할 수 있게 했다”고도 했다)

In his contribution, Representative Jang also justified his own visit to the U.S., which had sparked controversy domestically. (장 대표는 기고문에서 국내에서 논란이 됐던 자신의 미국 방문을 정당화하기도 했다.)

He stated, "The longest-lasting alliances in history were built not by treaties alone, but together with trust. And trust begins with listening. As one of the 300 members of the South Korean National Assembly, I came to Washington to hear what Americans see, what they expect, and what they believe this partnership should look like. This is a conversation that should have happened long ago." item.title: On-Site Investigation of Burning HMM NAMU in Hormuz Concludes... Presidential Office Says "Fire Cause Under Evaluation" (호르무즈서 불난 나무호 현장조사 종료…청 “화재 원인 평가 중”)
item.description:
The on-site investigation has concluded regarding the HMM NAMU, which caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz. (호르무즈해협에서 화재가 발생한 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호에 대한 현장조사가 마무리됐다.)

A presidential office official stated on the 10th, "The investigation team has completed the necessary on-site inspection," adding, "After concluding their on-site activities, they plan to return individually depending on flight schedules." The official further said, "We have received preliminary on-site investigation results and are currently reviewing and evaluating them with relevant agencies," and "We will provide an update on the cause of the fire on the NAMU after thorough review and evaluation of the investigation results with the relevant agencies." (청와대 관계자는 10일 “조사단이 필요한 현장조사를 마무리했다”며 “조사단은 현지 활동 마무리 뒤 항공 사정에 따라 개별 귀국할 예정”이라고 말했다. 이어 “1차적인 현장조사 결과를 받았으며 관계기관 간 검토 및 평가 중”이라며 “나무호 화재의 원인은 현장조사 결과에 대해 관계기관 간 검토 및 평가를 거쳐 답변드리겠다”고 말했다.)

Earlier, a government investigation team composed of three officials from the Maritime Safety Tribunal under the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries and four fire investigation experts from the National Fire Agency conducted a probe into the cause of the fire on the NAMU at Dubai Port on the 8th. The key issue is determining whether the fire that broke out on the NAMU on the 4th was due to internal factors or external factors such as an attack by Iran. Initially, the Korean government leaned toward the possibility of an attack, but National Security Office Director Seo Wook said on the 6th, "The possibility of an attack was raised early on, but after additional review of the intelligence, it appears an attack is not certain." (앞서 해양수산부 산하 해양안전심판원 3명과 소방청 감식 전문가 4명으로 구성된 정부 조사단은 지난 8일 두바이항에서 나무호에 대한 화재 원인 조사를 벌였다. 지난 4일 나무호에서 발생한 화재가 내부 요인인지, 이란 공격 등 외부 요인에 따른 것인지를 규명하는 것이 핵심이다. 애초 우리 정부는 피격 가능성에 무게를 뒀지만, 위성락 국가안보실장은 지난 6일 “초기에 피격 가능성이 거론됐는데, 정보를 추가 검토해보니 피격이 확실하지 않은 것 같다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Democrats' Cho Seung-rae: "Kim Kwan-young Can Never Rejoin Party… Running as Independent is a Serious Breach of Party Loyalty" (민주 조승래 “김관영, 영원히 복당 불가…무소속 출마는 해당 행위”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea announced on the 10th that Kim Kwan-young, who ran as an independent candidate in the Jeonbuk governor election for the June 3 local elections, stated, "This is not just a refusal to accept the party's nomination but also a serious breach of party loyalty, making it impossible for him to ever rejoin the party. The Democratic Party is not a party that one can enter and leave as they please." <<> Secretary General Cho Seung-rae said at a press briefing at the National Assembly on the same day, "There are cases of people who were expelled from the party and thus ineligible to run, who then left the party to run as independents or for other parties. Governor Kim Kwan-young of Jeonbuk is a prime example." Candidate Kim was expelled on the 1st after allegations arose during the Democratic Party's primary process of distributing cash for designated driver fees. <<> Secretary General Cho stated, "If such people get elected and then say they want to rejoin the party, can they simply rejoin at will? According to the Democratic Party's constitution, anyone who applied to run for public office, refused to accept the party's decision, left the party, and ran is permanently barred from rejoining. Governor Kim is a subject of permanent disqualification from rejoining. Even if he tries to enter the party at his own will, the party will not accept him." <<> Secretary General Cho also said, "If Governor Kim runs as an independent, it is naturally not only a refusal to accept the nomination but also a serious breach of party loyalty, so under the party constitution and rules, he can never rejoin the party. Likewise, if there are any party members helping Governor Kim, who is an independent, this is also a clear breach of party loyalty, and we will take strict measures." <<> Regarding Governor Kim's claim that 'the pro-Moon faction tried to frame him for insurrection to exclude him from the nomination,' Secretary General Cho said, "It is clearly based on false facts, so we will consider legal action." Regarding the 'envelope of cash' allegation against Kim, he also said, "He says about his actions that 'he gave the money out of an uncle's affection'. But will it be okay to give money out of an aunt or uncle's affection in the future? He is spouting absurd sophistry. It is shameless." <<> Secretary General Cho also pointed out cases where Democratic Party members who did not receive the party's nomination are running for the Fatherland Innovation Party. He warned, "There are claims from the Innovation Party side that 'Since we will merge with the Democratic Party anyway, those who were disciplined or denied nomination in the Democratic Party, if they join the Innovation Party, will be able to be absorbed into the Democratic Party (when merged).' They say they are siphoning off our party's resources. No matter what happens later—whether it's a merger, integration, or individual re-entry—the act of refusing to accept the party's nomination will not be erased." <<> Secretary General Cho announced on this day that a decision was made at a closed supreme council meeting to establish an internal party body called the 'June 3 Fair Election Investigation Special Committee.' <<> This body, chaired by Secretary General Cho, will take strict measures if it is confirmed during the election process that a Democratic Party figure supported a candidate from another party or an independent. It will also recognize those who worked devotedly during the local election process by reflecting their contributions. Secretary General Cho stated, "We will clearly distinguish between reward and punishment in the local election process. An attitude of 'party comes after self, not before'—meaning putting oneself before the party—is unacceptable within the party." <<> Reporter Koh Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당이 6·3 지방선거 전북지사 선거에 무소속으로 출마한 김관영 후보에 대해 “공천 불복일 뿐 아니라 중대한 해당 행위이기 때문에 영원히 복당이 불가능하다”며 “민주당이라는 공당은 본인 맘대로 들락날락할 수 있는 정당이 아니”라고 10일 밝혔다.)

item.title: Choi Young, 'Roh Moo-hyun's Driver' for 21 Years, Passes Away...Stayed by His Side from Assemblyman Days to After His Death (21년 ‘노무현의 발’ 최영 별세…국회의원 시절부터 서거 뒤까지 지켜)
item.description:
Choi Young, known as "Roh Moo-hyun's driver," passed away on the 10th. He was 62. (‘노무현의 운전기사’ 최영씨가 10일 별세했다. 향년 62.)

The deceased served as an executive secretary driving former President Roh Moo-hyun's car for 21 years, from 1988 to 2009. After failing the college entrance exam and while preparing for employment, his relationship with Roh began when Lee Gwang-jae, then an aide to Assemblyman Roh Moo-hyun, offered him the position of driver. (고인은 1988년부터 2009년까지 21년간 노무현 전 대통령의 차를 운전한 수행 비서였다. 대입에 실패하고 취업 준비중이었던 그에게 당시 이광재 노무현 의원실 보좌관이 노무현 의원의 운전기사를 제안하면서 인연이 시작됐다.)

Former President Roh had such deep trust in the deceased that he refused to change drivers even after being elected, declining the use of a specially manufactured bulletproof car. Ultimately, the deceased underwent a separate one-day "security driving" training session at the presidential office's security service and immediately began driving the armored sedan. (노 전 대통령은 당선자 시절 운전기사를 바꾸지 않겠다며 특수 제작된 방탄차 이용을 거절할 정도로 고인과의 신뢰가 두터웠다. 결국 고인이 청와대 경호실에서 하루 ‘경호운전’ 교습을 따로 받아 곧바로 방탄 승용차를 운전했다.)

The family reported that the deceased cited his visit to Pyongyang, his ability—thanks to holding a Class 1 large vehicle license—to personally drive former President Roh's bus when he appeared for prosecution questioning, and driving the hearse after former President Roh's death in 2009, as memorable moments. (고인은 평양 방문, 1종 대형 면허를 갖고 있어 검찰 출석 당시 노 전 대통령의 버스를 직접 몰 수 있었던 것, 2009년 노 전 대통령 서거 뒤 영구차를 몬 것 등을 기억에 남는 장면으로 꼽았다고 유족이 전했다.)

The deceased continued to drive for former First Lady Kwon Yang-sook until he was diagnosed with lung cancer last year, after former President Roh's passing. (고인은 노 전 대통령 서거 뒤 지난해 폐암 진단을 받을 때까지 권양숙 여사의 차를 운전했다.)

The funeral will be organized by the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation. On the official website of former President Roh Moo-hyun, "People Living in the World," the foundation stated, "We express our deep condolences on the passing of former Secretary Choi Young, who spent a long time with President Roh Moo-hyun." (장례는 노무현재단이 주관한다. 노무현재단은 노무현대통령 공식 누리집 사람사는 세상을 통해 “노무현 대통령과 긴 시간을 함께했던 고 최영 비서관의 별세에 깊은 애도를 표한다”고 밝혔다.)

Survivors include his wife, Kim Jung-hwa, one son and one daughter (Choi Jae-sik and Choi Joo-yeon), his older brother Choi Young-gun, and younger sister Choi Kyung-mi. The mortuary has been set up at the National Medical Center, and the funeral procession will depart at 8 a.m. on the 12th. (02)2262-4822. (유족은 부인 김정화씨와 1남1녀(최재식·최주연), 형 최영군씨, 동생 최경미씨 등이 있다. 빈소는 국립중앙의료원에 마련됐으며, 발인은 12일 오전 8시다. (02)2262-4822.)

Reporter Ha Uh-young haha@hani.co.kr (하어영 기자 haha@hani.co.kr)

item.title: North Korean Military Participates in Russia's Victory Day Parade for First Time, Flaunting 'Blood Alliance' (북한군, 러 전승절 열병식 첫 참가…‘혈맹관계’ 과시)
item.description:
North Korean troops participated in Russia's "Victory Day" military parade on the 9th (local time) for the first time in history, showcasing their blood alliance. (북한군이 지난 9일(현지시각) 러시아 ‘전승절’ 군사 퍼레이드에 사상 처음으로 참가해 혈맹 관계를 과시했다.)

The Rodong Sinmun and the Korean Central News Agency reported on the 10th that "a parade celebrating the 81st anniversary of the victory in the Great Patriotic War was held on Red Square in Moscow the previous day (the 9th), and at Russia's invitation, a combined contingent of the Korean People's Army from the Army, Navy, and Air Force took part in the Moscow Victory Parade." (노동신문과 조선중앙통신은 “모스크바 붉은광장에서 전날(9일) 위대한 조국전쟁승리 81돌 경축 열병식이 진행됐으며 러시아 초청에 따라 조선인민군 육해공군혼성종대가 모스크바 승리 열병식에 참가했다”고 10일 보도했다.)

The Rodong Sinmun emphasized North Korea's significant contribution to Russia's recapture of Kursk, stating that "alongside the columns of Russian soldiers, the column of soldiers of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, who displayed immortal feats in the battles to liberate Kursk, marched across Red Square." The contingent was led by Colonel General Choi Young-hoon. North Korea placed the related news with photos on the front and second pages of the Rodong Sinmun, aiming to show its citizens the solidity of the alliance with Russia. (노동신문은 “로씨야(러시아) 군인들의 열병종대들과 함께 꾸르스크(쿠르스크)를 해방하기 위한 전투들에서 불멸의 위훈을 떨친 조선민주주의인민공화국 군인들의 종대가 붉은광장을 행진했다”면서, 러시아의 쿠르스크 탈환에 북한군의 공헌이 컸음을 강조했다. 종대는 최영훈 육군 대좌가 이끌었다. 북한은 노동신문에 관련 소식을 사진과 함께 1·2면에 배치해 주민들에게 러시아와의 동맹관계가 공고함을 보여주려 했다.)

Kursk is a region in southwestern Russia, part of which was occupied by Ukrainian forces in August 2024, but Russia recaptured it with the help of North Korean troops. It is estimated that approximately 10,000 North Korean soldiers are currently fighting alongside Russian forces. (쿠르스크는 러시아 서남부 지역으로 2024년 8월 우크라이나군이 일부를 점령했지만, 북한군의 도움으로 러시아가 탈환했다. 현재 약 1만명의 북한군이 러시아군과 함께 전투에 참여 중인 것으로 추산된다.)

Russia's state-run TASS news agency also highlighted the unprecedented participation of a North Korean military unit in the Victory Day parade. Russian President Vladimir Putin met with the commanders after the parade and expressed his gratitude. (러시아 관영 타스 통신도 북한군 부대가 전승절 열병식에 참가한 것은 처음이라면서 비중 있게 보도했다. 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령은 열병식 뒤 지휘관을 만나 감사의 뜻을 표했다.)

Professor Im Eul-chul of the Far East Research Institute at Kyungnam University interpreted this as "an attempt to directly or indirectly expect compensation from Russia based on the logic that Russia's Kursk was defended with the blood of North Korean troops, to boost the pride of the North Korean military and the legitimacy of the regime, and to flaunt the construction of a North Korea-Russia alliance rivaling the South Korea-U.S. alliance." Kim Jong-un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and Chairman of the State Affairs Commission, did not attend the Victory Day event. Instead, he sent a congratulatory message to President Putin on the 9th, emphasizing the strategic partnership between North Korea and Russia. (임을출 경남대 극동문제연구소 교수는 “러시아의 쿠르스크를 북한군의 피로 지켜냈다는 논리로 러시아의 반대급부를 직간접으로 기대하고, 북한군의 자긍심과 체제 정당성을 고취하며 한-미 동맹에 버금가는 북-러 동맹 구축을 과시한 것”이라고 해석했다. 김정은 조선노동당 총비서 겸 국무위원장은 전승절 행사에 참석하지는 않았다. 대신 그는 지난 9일 푸틴 대통령에게 축전을 보내 북-러 전략적 동반자 관계를 강조했다.)

The event was significantly scaled down compared to previous years. No advanced weapons were displayed, and only soldiers marched. The parade ended in 45 minutes. (행사는 예년보다 규모가 대폭 축소됐다. 첨단무기는 등장하지 않았고 병사들만 행진했다. 행사는 45분 만에 끝났다.)

This appears to be related to a Ukrainian suicide drone attack on a high-rise apartment building 7 km from Red Square on the 4th. Prolonging the parade was likely considered to expose it to potential Ukrainian attacks. (이는 지난 4일 우크라이나 자폭 드론이 붉은광장에서 7㎞ 떨어진 고층 아파트를 공격한 것과 무관하지 않아 보인다. 장시간 열병식을 할 경우 우크라이나의 공격에 노출될 수 있다는 점을 고려한 것 같다.)

The worsening public opinion due to the war, which has lasted over four years, also played a role. Recently, rumors of a "coup" have been spreading within Russia. U.S. news network CNN reported, citing European intelligence agency reports, that President Putin, concerned about assassination or a military coup, has completely stopped inspecting military units this year. (4년을 넘긴 전쟁 탓에 여론이 악화한 것도 작용했다. 최근엔 러시아 내부에 ‘쿠데타설’까지 번지고 있다. 미국 시엔엔(CNN) 방송은 유럽 정보기관 보고서를 인용해 암살·군부 쿠데타를 우려한 푸틴 대통령이 올해 들어 군부대 시찰을 완전히 중단했다고 보도했다.)

Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee, Reporter Cheon Ho-seong minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자, 천호성 기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: “I will be judged by results, including attracting the Korea Airports Corporation…I will make Chungbuk a special entrepreneurship province.” (“공항공사 유치 등 결과로 평가받겠다…창업특별도 충북 만들 것”)
item.description:
“What matters is ability, not history. I will be evaluated by results.” (“중요한 것은 이력보다 능력이다. 결과로 평가받겠다.”)

Shin Yong-han, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate challenging for the Chungbuk governor position in the June 3 local elections, has a history connected directly and indirectly to both former and current presidents. He served as the Youth Committee Chairman under the Park Geun-hye administration and as the Deputy Director of Policy Coordination Office for former President Yoon Seok-yeol’s presidential campaign. Under the Lee Jae-myung administration, he was appointed Vice Chairman of the Presidential Committee for Local Autonomy and Balanced Development. In an interview with The Hankyoreh on the 8th at the ‘Hwangso (Bull) Camp’ office in Cheongju Industrial Complex, he immediately showed a photo on his phone titled ‘Father and the Bull.’ “About 20 years ago, that was a stud bull my father raised, worth around 20 million won at the time. Like my father, like the bull, it’s my resolve to work steadfastly, and it’s my symbol,” he said. He added, “Being called ‘so-and-so’s person’ rather than by my name is burdensome, but it’s my fate. In any administration, I participated in efforts to revive youth and local regions, playing various roles. I will leverage my experience and strengths to demonstrate a balanced, practical, and innovative administration.” <<> —Why is "Shin Yong-han the governor of Chungbuk"? <<> “For Chungbuk, which stands at a turning point for change and innovation, taking a leap forward with existing methods is difficult. I have designed and implemented policies for local autonomy and balanced development, and I have the capability to collaborate with the Lee Jae-myung administration to produce results.” <<> —What are your key pledges? <<> “I plan to make Chungbuk a ‘special entrepreneurship province.’ I will gather startups and innovative companies that will lead the future to turn it into a mecca for entrepreneurship. Chungbuk has Osong, a specialized healthcare complex, and Ochang, where advanced information and communication technologies and companies are concentrated. In Osong Bio Square, KAIST will lead the establishment of world-class companies and research institutes. Centered on these, I will create ‘Semi-Pangyo’ and ‘Semi-Daedeok’ to develop them into Korea’s Silicon Valley. Additionally, I will pursue ‘local entrepreneurship’ that leverages regional characteristics like Chungju Gwanagol and Cheongju Suamgol, alongside ‘tech entrepreneurship’ concentrating industries and technologies such as K-Beauty. There is also a K-Pop arena.” <<> —Along with youth entrepreneurship, your ‘failure spec’ pledge stands out. <<> “‘Failure spec’ comes from my experience. Before becoming a business executive or venture CEO, I also experienced failure. Failure is a good experience and an asset for the future. I will establish the Chungbuk Re-startup Center to provide opportunities and support so that even if people fail, they can rise again. Chungbuk will become a land of opportunity.” <<> —Regarding your experience on the Presidential Committee for Local Autonomy, there are expectations concerning the relocation of public institutions. <<> “Local regions face concerns about population decline, while the Seoul metropolitan area struggles with overcrowding and concentration. A second round of public institution relocation is needed for local autonomy and balanced development, and this will materialize from the second half of this year. The government is preparing to relocate about half of the 369 public institutions designated for relocation. If I become Chungbuk governor, I plan to actively pursue attracting institutions like the Korea Airports Corporation.” <<> —The integration of Daejeon and South Chungcheong has fallen through. What are your thoughts on the integration of the Chungcheong region? <<> “I envy the support following the integration of Gwangju and South Jeolla. The Chungcheong region is currently operating a ‘metropolitan federation,’ and we need to prepare for integration step by step based on this. Chungbuk should cultivate and develop a ‘strong small special province’ by revising the existing Special Act on the Central Inland Region, then confidently approach integration without hesitation. I intend to lay the groundwork for Chungcheong regional integration with the heads of Daejeon, South Chungcheong, and Sejong.” <<> —There were also lawsuits and complaints during the primary process. What is your ‘One Team’ plan? <<> “People talk about legal risks, but there’s absolutely nothing problematic. I want to bring together all those who participated in the primary, including candidate Noh Young-min, who has experience as Chief of Staff to the President and Ambassador to China. Candidate Noh proposed a pledge to attract Samsung—if that’s possible, I would like to appoint him as Chairperson of the Investment Attraction Special Committee to learn from his experience and know-how.” <<> Text and photos by reporter Oh Yoon-ju sting@hani.co.kr ( 6·3 지방선거에서 충북지사직에 도전하는 신용한 더불어민주당 후보는 전·현 정부 대통령과 직간접으로 연결되는 이력을 지녔다. 그는 박근혜 정부 청년위원장, 윤석열 전 대통령 대선 캠프 정책총괄지원실장을 지냈다. 이재명 정부에서는 대통령 직속 지방시대위원회 부위원장으로 선임됐다. 지난 8일 청주 공단오거리 ‘황소 캠프’ 사무실에서 한겨레와 인터뷰한 그는 대뜸 휴대전화에 있는 ‘아버지와 황소’ 사진을 보여줬다. “20여년 전 아버지가 키운 씨소(종우)인데 당시 2천만원 정도였다. 아버지처럼, 황소처럼 우직하게 일하려는 다짐이자 제 상징”이라고 했다. 그는 “이름보다 ‘누구누구의 사람’으로 불리는 게 부담이지만, 운명이다. 어느 정부에서든 청년·지방을 살리는 데 참여했고, 다양한 역할을 했다. 경험·장점을 살려 균형감 있고 실용적인 혁신 도정을 보이겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek Ahead of US Visit: “No Problem Speeding Up OPCON Transfer” (방미 앞둔 안규백 국방 장관 “전작권 전환 속도 내는 것 문제없다”)
item.description:
Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek expressed his determination for an early return of wartime operational control (OPCON) on the 10th, stating, “We have prepared systematically, stably, and consistently.” <<> Minister Ahn made these remarks while meeting with reporters at Incheon International Airport before departing for the United States to attend the ROK-U.S. Defense Ministers’ Meeting, saying, “I believe speeding up the OPCON transition is largely unproblematic. South Korean and U.S. authorities made significant progress in 2015 under a conditions-based agreement regarding the OPCON transition.” <<> On his first visit to the United States since taking office as minister, Ahn will stay in the U.S. from the 11th (local time) through the 14th, including a meeting with U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, and will meet with the Acting Secretary of the Navy, the Chairman of the Senate Armed Services Committee, and the Chairman of the Seapower Subcommittee. <<> Minister Ahn and Secretary Hegseth are expected to focus discussions on OPCON transition and issues related to nuclear-powered submarines during their meeting. Minister Ahn said, “During last year’s ROK-U.S. Security Consultative Meeting (SCM), we agreed to finalize the year of (OPCON transition) at this year’s year-end SCM. item.title: Busan's 'North Gap Battle' Begins: Park Min-sik and Han Dong-hoon Hold Rival Opening Ceremonies; Ha Jung-woo Enters the Fray an Hour Later (부산 ‘북갑대전’ 개막…박민식·한동훈 ‘맞불’ 개소식, 하정우 1시간 뒤 ‘참전’)
item.description:
"The conservatives who fight among themselves, the self-righteous conservatives, and the outdated conservatives must now step aside." (Park Min-sik, People Power Party candidate for Busan North Gap) (“내부총질하는 보수, 유아독존 보수, 구태 보수는 이제 물러가야 한다.”(박민식 국민의힘 부산 북갑 후보))

"I will win in Buk-gu and surely make it to the Blue House." (Han Dong-hoon, independent candidate for Busan North Gap) (“북구에서 승리해 반드시 청와대로 가겠다.”(한동훈 무소속 부산 북갑 후보))

At 2 PM on the 10th, the Deokcheon-dong area of Busan's Buk-gu was ablaze with a three-way battle among conservative opposition candidates. Park Min-sik of the People Power Party and independent Han Dong-hoon, both running in the Busan North Gap by-election, held their campaign office opening ceremonies on the same day and time, separated by just 600 meters—a 10-minute walk—across Deokcheon-dong's Youth Street. (10일 오후 2시. 부산 북구 덕천동 일대는 보수 야권 후보들의 세 대결로 뜨겁게 달아올랐다. 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 박민식 국민의힘 후보와 한동훈 무소속 후보가 덕천동 젊음의 거리를 사이에 두고 불과 600m, 걸어서 10분 거리에서 한날한시 선거사무소 개소식을 열면서다.)

At the Daehyang Building in Buk-gu, where Park's ceremony took place, the full leadership of the People Power Party turned out to showcase their strength. Attendees included Party Leader Jang Dong-hyuk, Floor Leader Song Eon-seok, Secretary-General Jeong Hee-yong, 24 incumbent lawmakers, and Busan Mayor Park Hyung-jun. Some 5,000 supporters of Park (according to the organizers) packed the venue, lending their support. (박 후보 개소식이 열린 북구 대향빌딩에는 국민의힘 지도부가 총출동해 세를 과시했다. 장동혁 대표, 송언석 원내대표, 정희용 사무총장을 포함해 현역 의원 24명과 박형준 부산시장이 참석했다. 박 후보 지지자 5000여명(주최 쪽 추산)도 빼곡히 들어서 힘을 보탰다.)

Party Leader Jang Dong-hyuk, seemingly targeting Han, said, "The conservative party has fallen on hard times because of internal divisions," adding, "It shouldn't be someone who sows seeds of conflict and division, but someone like Park Min-sik, who steadfastly upholds conservatism, who should rebuild the conservative party." He continued, "We need not someone who seeks to exploit the People Power Party, but Park Min-sik, who can truly love the People Power Party." (장동혁 대표는 한 후보를 겨냥한 듯 “보수정당이 어렵게 된 것은 우리끼리 분열해서”라며 “갈등과 분열의 씨앗을 뿌린 사람이 아니라, 박민식처럼 굳건하게 보수를 지킨 사람이 보수정당을 새롭게 만들어야 한다”고 말했다. 이어 “국민의힘이라는 정당을 이용하려는 사람이 아니라 국민의힘을 진정 사랑할 수 있는 박민식이 필요하다”고 덧붙였다.)

Near the Hanjin Building in Buk-gu, where Han's ceremony was held, about 10,000 supporters (according to the organizers) gathered. In attendance were former lawmaker Seo Byung-soo, who left the People Power Party to serve as honorary campaign committee chair, and Jo Gap-je, CEO of Jo Gap-je Dot Com. However, pro-Han Dong-hoon lawmakers from the People Power Party did not attend. Han had dissuaded them from coming after the People Power Party leadership threatened to discipline any pro-Han lawmakers who attended the ceremony. Supporters began gathering around his campaign office about two hours before the event. Most were dressed in "Monami fashion"—white tops and black bottoms. (한 후보 개소식이 열린 북구 한진빌딩 근처에는 한 후보 지지자 1만여명(주최 쪽 추산)이 모였다. 이 자리에는 국민의힘을 탈당해 명예선대위원장을 맡은 서병수 전 의원과 조갑제 조갑제닷컴 대표도 참석했다. 다만 국민의힘 친한동훈계 의원들은 참석하지 않았다. 한 후보는 국민의힘 지도부가 개소식에 참석하는 친한계 의원을 징계하겠다고 벼르자 이들의 참석을 만류했다. 그의 선거 사무소 주변에는 개소식이 열리기 2시간 정도 전부터 지지자들이 모여들었다. 이들은 대부분 흰색 상의에 검정색 하의를 입은 ‘모나미 패션’이었다.)

Han stated, "I thought about inviting powerful people to show off, but I prepared this ceremony as a festival with the residents of Buk-gu," adding, "I will win in Buk-gu and surely make it to the Blue House." Chung Hyung-keun, a former lawmaker from the Grand National Party (the predecessor of the People Power Party) and chair of Han's fundraising committee, who has been criticized for his involvement in torture investigations during his time at the National Security Planning Agency, did not attend, citing 'health reasons.' The physical clashes between supporters of Park and Han that some had feared did not occur. (한 후보는 “힘센 사람들을 불러 자랑할까도 생각해봤지만, 북구 주민과의 축제로 개소식을 준비했다”며 “북구에서 승리해 반드시 청와대로 가겠다”고 말했다. 국가안전기획부 시절 고문 수사 논란으로 비판받은 후원회장 정형근 전 한나라당(국민의힘의 전신) 의원은 ‘건강상의 이유’로 참석하지 않았다. 일부에서 우려했던 박 후보와 한 후보 지지자들 사이의 물리적 충돌은 일어나지 않았다.)

Ha Jung-woo, the Democratic Party candidate for the Busan North Gap by-election, also showed he was not backing down from the verbal sparring. Ha held his opening ceremony an hour later, at 3 PM, at the former lawmaker Jeon Jae-soo's congressional office in Gupo-dong, Buk-gu. Ha declared, "Through the invincible fleet of Buk-gu development led by Lee Jae-myung, Jeon Jae-soo, and Ha Jung-woo, I will connect budgets, systems, and people to accelerate the progress of Buk-gu." (하정우 더불어민주당 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 후보도 신경전에 빠지지 않는 모습이었다. 하 후보는 이들보다 1시간 뒤인 오후 3시 북구 구포동에 있는 옛 전재수 의원 국회의원 사무소에서 개소식을 열었다. 하 후보는 “이재명-전재수-하정우로 이어지는 북구 발전의 무적함대를 통해 예산과 제도, 사람을 연결해 북구의 시간을 앞당기겠다”고 했다.)

Attending the ceremony were Jeon Jae-soo, the Busan mayoral candidate serving as fundraising chair; Kim Young-choon, former Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, serving as honorary campaign committee chair; and Assemblyman Kim Young-jin, deputy chair of the talent recruitment committee. Rep. Jung Cheong-rae, who sparked controversy with the 'Oppa scandal,' attended Jeon Jae-soo's campaign office opening the previous day but did not attend Ha's ceremony. (개소식에는 후원회장을 맡은 전재수 부산시장 후보와 명예선대위원장을 맡은 김영춘 전 해양수산부 장관, 인재영입위원회 부위원장 김영진 의원 등이 참석했다. ‘오빠 논란’으로 설화를 빚은 정청래 대표는 전날 전재수 후보 선거사무소 개소식에 참석했으나 이날 하 후보 개소식에는 참석하지 않았다.)

The race in Busan North Gap is a tight contest. In a poll conducted by SBS and polling agency Ipsos from the 1st to the 3rd, support stood at 38% for Ha, 26% for Park, and 21% for Han. Meanwhile, a survey by Busan MBC and Han-gil Research during the same period showed Ha at 34.3%, Park at 21.5%, and Han at 33.5% (for details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website). (부산 북갑은 백중세다. 에스비에스(SBS)-여론조사기관 입소스가 지난 1∼3일 실시한 여론조사에서 지지도는 하 후보 38%, 박 후보 26%, 한 후보 21% 순이었다. 같은 기간 부산문화방송(MBC)-한길리서치 조사에서는 하 후보 34.3%, 박 후보 21.5%, 한 후보 33.5%로 나타났다(자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집 참조).)

Busan/Reporters Jo Hee-yeon, Kim Wan, and Go Han-sol choh@hani.co.kr (부산/조희연 김완 기자, 고한솔 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party Election Committee Launches…Jeong Cheong-rae: “We Must Judge the Forces That Dream of Another Insurrection” (민주당 선대위 출범…정청래 “다시 내란 꿈꾸는 세력 심판”)
item.description:
With 24 days left until the June 3 local elections, the Democratic Party of Korea launched its election strategy committee on the 10th, centering on the key phrase “restoring the nation,” and fully shifted into local election campaign mode. <<> Jeong Cheong-rae, who serves as the general co-chair of the election committee, said at the launch ceremony held at the National Assembly, “In this election, we must surely judge the arrogant forces that dream of another insurrection through the ‘Yoon Again’ nominations.” He added, “Today, we begin the great journey of the ‘Republic of Korea National Restoration Election Strategy Committee’ to fulfill the historic mission of our time.” <<> Representative Jeong stated, “This election is a golden opportunity to support the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration and complete balanced national development.” He said, “The regional governors, mayors, provincial councilors, and municipal councilors nominated by the Democratic Party will create local governments that work as effectively as Lee Jae-myung.” He further emphasized, “When the Lee Jae-myung government and local governments operate in seamless alignment, like meshing gears, we can also achieve local-led growth through the ‘5 Mega-Regions and 3 Special Self-Governing Provinces’ strategy.” <<> The composition of the election committee focused on strengthening local organizations. Representative Jeong explained, “This election committee is structured as a ‘field-tight’ organization that approaches the people more closely and swiftly.” He added, “The central election committee was formed with a minimal number of people who can incorporate diverse voices, and heavyweight figures, including former and current supreme council members, have been assigned to oversee each region.” <<> Efforts were also made to secure diversity through the recruitment of outside figures. Former North Chungcheong Governor Lee Si-jong, WHO advisor on climate, AI, and health Ahn Seon-ha, Daegu-born surgeon Geum Hee-jung (known as the “eldest daughter of TK” during the last presidential campaign), and naturalized Korean citizen from Myanmar Lee Bona were named as co-chairs of the election committee alongside floor leader Park Chan-dae. Representative Jeong described it as “a grand unity and comprehensive inclusion-type election committee that gathers not only the Democratic Party’s talent but also new figures who embody the people’s aspirations.” He explained, “It reflects the Democratic Party’s will to be a large vessel that embraces the voices of all people, transcending class, gender, region, and generation.” <<> Supreme council members Lee Un-ju, Hwang Myeong-seon, Kang Deuk-gu, Lee Seong-yoon, Moon Jeong-bok, Park Ji-won, and Park Gyu-hwan will serve as co-chairs of the election committee. Actor Lee Won-jong has been appointed as the “Alley-Alley Election Committee Chair,” overseeing regional campaigns. <<> Reporter Go Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당이 6·3 지방선거를 24일 앞둔 10일 ‘국가 정상화’를 열쇳말로 내건 선거대책위원회를 출범하고 지방선거 체제로 본격 전환했다.)

item.title: Why the Lee Jae-myung Administration is Confident: "The Surge in Housing Prices is Different from the Moon Jae-in Administration" (“집값 급등, 문 정부 때와 달라” 이재명 정부 자신하는 이유는)
item.description:
As the heavy capital gains tax system on multiple homeowners resumes today (June 10) after four years, the government assesses that the rampant housing price hikes seen under the Moon Jae-in administration will not be repeated. There is particular optimism that the market will see an increase in new listings through measures such as exempting non-resident single homeowners from land transaction permits and reforming the permanent capital gains tax benefits previously granted to rental business operators. (다주택자에 대한 양도세 중과 제도가 4년 만인 10일 재개된 가운데, 정부는 문재인 정부 때와 같은 집값 폭등세는 재현되지 않을 것이라고 판단하고 있다. 특히 비거주 1주택자에 대한 토지거래허가 예외 적용과 임대사업자에게 주어진 영구적 양도세 혜택 개편 등을 통해 시장에 추가 매물이 나올 것으로 기대하는 분위기다.)

The government's expectation of a different outcome from the past stems from its handling of a "tax card" designed to encourage property listings. This aligns with remarks made by Kim Yong-beom, head of the Cheong Wa Dae policy office, during a press briefing on June 4, where he stated, "President Lee Jae-myung has previewed a rationalization of housing taxes by differentiating them by type—such as multiple homeowners, non-resident single homeowners, and ultra-high-value properties—making the situation different from that under the Moon Jae-in administration." Previously, the Moon administration had imposed a 10-percentage-point surtax for two homeowners and a 20-percentage-point surtax for three homeowners in targeted adjustment areas through the August 2, 2017 measures, followed by additional 10-percentage-point increases for each in the July 10, 2020 measures. After the implementation of the July 10 measures in June 2021, an analysis indicated market side effects, including a lock-in effect on listings, leading to phenomena such as the so-called "one prime property" trend. ( 정부가 과거와 다른 양상을 기대하는 근거는 매물을 유도할 ‘세제 카드’를 만지작거리고 있기 때문이다. 김용범 청와대 정책실장이 지난 4일 기자간담회에서 “이재명 대통령이 다주택자, 비거주 1주택, 초고가 등 유형별로 차등화해 주택에 대한 세제를 합리화한다는 걸 예고했다”며 “그게 (문재인 정부와) 다른 상황”이라고 밝힌 것도 같은 맥락이다. 앞서 문재인 정부는 2017년 8·2 대책을 통해 조정대상지역 내 2주택자 중과세율을 10%포인트, 3주택자 중과세율을 20%포인트 가산했고, 2020년 7·10 대책 때 각각 10%포인트씩 추가 가산했다. 7·10 대책 시행일(2021년 6월) 이후 시장에서는 매물 잠김으로 이른바 ‘똘똘한 한채’ 현상 등 부작용이 나타났다는 분석이 나온 바 있다.)

The first item under discussion is the reduction of long-term holding special deduction benefits for non-resident single homeowners. President Lee lent weight to this direction on April 24 in a post on X (formerly Twitter), stating, "To properly protect the residence of single homeowners, it is appropriate to reduce deductions for non-resident holding periods and increase deductions for resident holding periods accordingly." Currently, a single homeowner can receive up to 40% based on holding period and up to 40% based on residency period for long-term holding special deductions, allowing a maximum of 80% of capital gains to be deducted. Observations suggest a reshuffling to emphasize residency periods. However, the government remains cautious about adjusting holding taxes, such as property tax and comprehensive real estate tax. A Cheong Wa Dae official told The Hankyoreh on June 10, "As holding taxes are a last resort, we will make decisions based on market conditions." ( 가장 먼저 거론되는 것이 비거주 1주택자의 장기보유특별공제 혜택 축소 카드다. 이 대통령은 지난달 24일 엑스(X)에 “1주택자의 주거를 제대로 보호하려면 비거주 보유 기간에 대한 감면을 축소하고, 그만큼 거주·보유 기간에 대한 감면을 늘리는 것이 맞다”며 이런 방향에 힘을 실었다. 현재 1주택자는 보유 기간에 따라 최대 40%, 거주 기간에 따라 최대 40%의 장기보유특별공제를 받아 최대 80%까지 양도차익을 공제받을 수 있는데 이를 거주 기간 중심으로 재편할 것이란 관측이 나온다. 다만 재산세·종합부동산세 등 보유세 손질에는 신중한 태도다. 청와대 관계자는 10일 한겨레에 “보유세는 최후의 수단인 만큼 시장 상황을 보고 판단할 것”이라고 말했다.)

Additionally, the administration plans to encourage new listings through measures such as exempting non-resident single homeowners from land transaction permits. Minister of Land, Infrastructure, and Transport Kim Yoon-deok wrote on Facebook this day, "We intend to review exemption measures for land transaction permits for non-resident single homeowners and whether offering permanent capital gains tax reductions to rental business operators is appropriate. Although there are significant concerns about listing lock-downs after the resumption of heavy capital gains taxes, the People's Sovereignty Government will be different." ( 아울러 비거주 1주택자에 대한 토지거래허가 예외 적용 등을 통해 추가 매물을 유도한다는 방침이다. 김윤덕 국토교통부 장관은 이날 페이스북에 “비거주 1주택자 등에 대한 토지거래허가 예외 방안과 임대사업자에게 영구적 양도세 감면 혜택을 주는 것이 적정한지 검토할 예정”이라며 “양도세 중과 재개 후 매물 잠김 우려가 크지만, 국민주권정부는 다를 것”이라고 적었다.)

He further emphasized, "The Lee Jae-myung administration is not merely focused on stabilizing the real estate market but is pursuing fundamental institutional reforms out of a pressing recognition that without removing barriers to income classes and regional mobility, the future and unity of South Korea cannot be secured." ( 그러면서 그는 “이재명 정부는 단순 부동산 시장 안정 관점이 아니라 소득계층과 지역 간 계층이동의 장벽 해소 없이는 대한민국의 미래와 통합을 담보할 수 없다는 절박한 인식하에서 근본적인 제도개혁을 추진 중”이라고 강조했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr ( 서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Breaking] Government, Regarding the NAMUHO Fire: "Unidentified Flying Object Caused External Impact" ([속보] 정부, 나무호 화재 “미확인 비행물체가 외부 충격”)
item.description:
<<>> The government announced on the 10th that the fire that occurred on the HMM NAMUHO while it was anchored in the Strait of Hormuz was due to an external impact. ()

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated on the evening of the same day, "A joint government investigation team conducted a field investigation on the 8th regarding the HMM NAMUHO anchored in the Strait of Hormuz," and added, "The investigation confirmed that an unidentified flying object struck the stern of the HMM vessel." However, it is seen as being caused by an 'unidentified flying object' rather than underwater drones or floating mines, which had been suggested by some. ( 정부가 호르무즈 해협에서 정박 중이던 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호에서 발생한 화재 원인이 외부 충격 때문이라고 10일 발표했다. )

Earlier, a seven-member investigation team, including investigators from the Korean Maritime Safety Tribunal and forensic experts from the National Fire Agency, began on-site investigations on the 8th, the day after the NAMUHO arrived at the Dubai port shipyard, and concluded the investigation on this day. The team analyzed the VDR (Voyage Data Recorder) and CCTV footage, which serve as the ship's black box, and also listened to the crew's testimonies. ( 외교부는 이날 저녁 “호르무즈 해협에 정박중이던 에이치엠엠 나무호 관련 정부 합동 조사단이 현장 조사를 지난 8 실시했다”며 “조사 결과 미상의 비행체가 에이치엠엠 선박 선미를 타격한 것으로 확인했다”고 발표했다. 다만 일각에서 제기됐던 수중 드론이나 부유 기뢰는 아닌 ‘미확인 비행물체’에 의한 충격으로 보고 있다.)

A Cheong Wa Dae official also said on that day, "We have received the preliminary results of the field investigation and are currently reviewing and evaluating them with relevant agencies," and added, "We will provide an answer regarding the cause of the NAMUHO fire after a review and evaluation of the field investigation results by relevant agencies." ( 앞서 해양안전심판원 조사관과 소방청 감식 전문가 등 조사단 7명은 나무호가 두바이항 조선소에 도착한 다음 날인 지난 8일부터 현장 조사를 벌였고, 이날 조사를 마무리했다. 조사단은 사고 당시 나무호의 블랙박스격인 브이디알(VDR) 시시티브이(CCTV) 영상을 분석하고, 선원들의 증언도 청취했다.)

As the cause of the NAMUHO explosion and fire has been found to be from an external impact, Cheong Wa Dae and the government are expected to maintain a cautious stance until they further confirm the attacker and the circumstances. There are particular concerns that a hasty announcement could lead to diplomatic and security repercussions amid heightened tensions in the Strait of Hormuz. ( 청와대 관계자도 이날 “1차적인 현장조사 결과를 받았으며, 관계기관 간 검토 및 평가 중”이라며 “나무호 화재의 원인은 현장조사 결과에 대한 관계기관 간 검토 및 평가를 거쳐 답변드리겠다”고 말했다.)

The Iranian government maintains that it has nothing to do with the NAMUHO ship explosion and fire. On the 6th, the Iranian Embassy in South Korea issued a statement saying, "We strongly reject and firmly deny all claims that the armed forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran were involved in the incident related to the damage sustained by the South Korean ship in the Strait of Hormuz." ( 나무호 폭발·화재 원인이 외부 충격에 의한 것으로 조사된 만큼, 청와대와 정부는 공격 주체와 경위 등을 추가 확인할 때까지 신중한 태도를 유지할 것으로 보인다. 특히 호르무즈해협 긴장이 고조된 상황에서 섣부른 발표가 외교·안보 파장으로 이어질 가능성을 우려하는 분위기다. )

Previously, an explosion and fire occurred in the engine room of the NAMUHO, which was anchored in waters near the United Arab Emirates (UAE) inside the Strait of Hormuz, around 8:40 p.m. on the 4th. Immediately after the incident, the government gave weight to the possibility of an attack based on statements from crew members, but later showed caution, saying it could not be certain of an attack. On the 6th, National Security Office Director Suh Hoon said, "Initially, the possibility of an attack was raised, but after further reviewing the information, it seems the attack is not certain," and added, "There was no flooding or tilting of the ship." ( 이란 정부는 나무호 선박 폭발·화재가 자신들과 관련 없다는 태도를 유지하고 있다. 주한이란대사관은 지난 6일 “호르무즈해협에서 한국 선박이 입은 피해와 관련된 사건에 이란 공화국의 군이 개입했다는 모든 주장을 단호하게 거부하고 강력히 부인한다”는 내용의 성명을 발표하기도 했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr ( 앞서, 호르무즈해협 안쪽 아랍에미리트(UAE) 인근 해역에 정박해 있던 나무호 기관실에서 폭발과 화재가 발생한 건 지난 4일 오후 8시40분께다. 정부는 사건 직후 선원 등 진술을 토대로 피격 가능성에 무게를 뒀지만, 이후 피격을 확신할 수 없다며 신중한 태도를 보였다. 위성락 국가안보실장은 지난 6일 “초기에 피격 가능성이 거론됐는데, 정보를 추가 검토해보니 피격이 확실하지 않은 것 같다”며 “침수나 배의 기울임은 없었다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Foreign Ministry “Summons Iranian Ambassador to Korea… Explains HMM NAMU Fire Investigation Results” (외교부 “주한이란대사 불러…나무호 화재 조사결과 설명”)
item.description:
After the government officially confirmed on the 10th that the fire that broke out on the HMM NAMU vessel anchored in the Strait of Hormuz was caused by an impact from an external aircraft, it summoned Iranian Ambassador to Korea Saeed Koozechi to the foreign ministry building. (정부가 10일 호르무즈해협에서 정박 중이던 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호에서 발생한 화재 원인이 외부 비행체의 충격 때문이라고 공식 확인한 뒤, 사이드 쿠제치 주한이란대사를 외교부 청사로 불렀다.)

Foreign Ministry spokesperson Park Il explained the summoning of Ambassador Koozechi to the ministry building, stating, “We are communicating with relevant countries based on the facts confirmed so far, and the government plans to take necessary measures going forward. Since Iran is one of the relevant countries, the Iranian ambassador visited the ministry building to be briefed on our investigation results.” Ambassador Koozechi is scheduled to meet with First Vice Foreign Minister Park Yoon-ju to discuss the issue. Spokesperson Park Il added, “We are not presuming the perpetrator of the attack at this point.” (박일 외교부 대변인은 쿠제치 대사를 외교부 청사로 부른 데 대해 “현재까지 확인된 사실 관계를 바탕으로 관련국과 소통하고 있으며, 정부는 앞으로 필요한 대응을 취해 나갈 예정”이라면서, “이란은 관련국에 해당되기 때문에 우리 조사 결과를 설명하기 위해 주한이란대사가 청사를 방문한 것”이라고 밝혔다. 쿠제치 대사는 박윤주 외교부 1차관과 만나 이 문제를 논의한다. 박일 대변인은 “현재 공격의 주체를 예단하지 않는다”고 말했다.)

Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: HMM NIMU Hit Confirmed by ‘External Aircraft’, Complicating Government Response (나무호 ‘외부 비행체’ 피격 확인, 복잡해진 정부 대응)
item.description:
The government has officially confirmed that the explosion and fire on the HMM NIMU, which was anchored in the Strait of Hormuz, was caused by a strike from an external aircraft. While the government has emphasized a cautious approach regarding the identity of the attacker, if confirmed to be Iran’s attack, it is highly likely to pose a dilemma in relations with both Iran and the United States. (정부가 호르무즈해협에 정박해있던 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호의 폭발·화재 원인이 외부 비행체의 타격 탓이라고 공식 확인했다. 정부는 공격 주체에 대해 신중한 태도를 강조했지만, 이란의 공격으로 확인될 경우 대이란, 대미 관계에서 난제를 안게 될 가능성이 높다.)

Park Il, Vice Spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, held an emergency briefing on the evening of the 10th and announced that a precise on-site investigation by a government investigation team found that “an ‘unidentified aircraft’ struck the stern of the HMM NIMU.” The team confirmed through hull damage and CCTV footage from the NIMU that, around 15:30 on the 4th (20:30 Korean time), two unidentified aircraft struck the port-side ballast tank outer plating of the HMM NIMU’s stern twice at approximately one-minute intervals, causing a fire. Immediately after the incident, the government had emphasized the possibility of an attack based on testimony from the crew and others, but National Security Office Director Suh Wook took a cautious stance on the 6th, stating “the attack is not certain.” Spokesperson Park explained, “At the time, it was because the crew or nearby ships could not identify the breach.” <<> Spokesperson Park repeatedly emphasized, “We do not prejudge the identity of the attacker.” However, the likelihood of it being an Iranian attack has increased. On the same day, First Vice Foreign Minister Park Yoon-joo summoned Iranian Ambassador to South Korea Saeed Koozechi to the foreign ministry building and explained the investigation results. After the meeting, Ambassador Koozechi, with a perplexed expression, told reporters, “We talked about general issues regarding the attack. Please direct your questions to the Korean Ministry of Foreign Affairs,” and left the building. The Iranian Embassy in Seoul had stated on the 6th, “We firmly reject and deny any claims that Iranian forces were involved in the incident concerning the damage to the Korean ship.” <<> The presidential office held a working-level meeting of the National Security Council (NSC) on the same day, with relevant ministries including the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries participating, to discuss the results of the investigation into the NIMU incident and countermeasures. The government plans to conduct a detailed analysis of the aircraft engine debris recovered from the scene to make a final determination on whether the aircraft was a drone or a missile, and whether it is linked to Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. <<> If the detailed investigation reveals an Iranian attack, significant repercussions are expected. <<> The government has been actively engaged in diplomacy with Iran, including sending a special envoy from the foreign minister and maintaining a local embassy, to ensure the safety of 26 Korean ships stranded in the Strait of Hormuz. Nevertheless, if it turns out that Iran attacked our ship and then denied it, a response will be unavoidable. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated, “We will thoroughly determine the cause and pursue all possible measures, including cooperation with the international community, to prevent recurrence.” <<> <<> There is potential for increased U.S. pressure on South Korea to join operations to open the Strait of Hormuz. <<> The strike on the NIMU occurred amid heightened tensions after U.S. President Donald Trump announced the launch of “Project Freedom” to assist in the evacuation of ships trapped in the Strait of Hormuz and Iran attempted to prevent U.S. forces from entering the strait. Immediately after the incident, President Trump, claiming the NIMU was attacked by Iran after acting alone, pressured South Korea to contribute to opening the strait. Although Trump suspended Project Freedom, the U.S. State Department separately proposed participation in a multinational coalition, the “International Maritime Security Construct” (IMSC), which South Korea has been reviewing. Spokesperson Park Il stated, “We will explain the investigation results to the U.S. side,” and added, “We are also closely reviewing the issue of participating in the U.S. initiative for the IMSC.” <<> Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr ( 박일 외교부 대변인은 10일 저녁 긴급 브리핑을 열고 정부조사단의 현장 정밀 조사 결과 “‘미상의 비행체’가 에이치엠엠 나무호의 선미를 타격한 것으로 확인했다”고 발표했다. 조사단은 지난 4일 15시30분(한국시각 저녁 20시30분)께 미상의 비행체 2기가 HMM 나무호 선미 좌현 평형수 탱크 외판을 약 1분 간격으로 2차례 타격해 화재가 일어났음을 선체 손상과 나무호 CCTV 화면 등을 통해 확인했다. 정부는 사건 직후 선원 등 진술을 토대로 피격 가능성에 무게를 뒀지만 위성락 국가안보실장은 지난 6일 “피격이 확실치 않다”며 신중한 태도를 취했다. 박 대변인은 “당시에는 선원이나 인근 선박을 통해서 파공을 식별하지 못하였기 때문”이라고 설명했다. )
